nodes.label: Launch Hardening Issue Tracker
nodes.rationale: Pre-launch audit tracker; every fix is verified (tests / manage.py check / eslint) before being marked done; deploys require Django+Celery restart and frontend rebuild.

nodes.label: Signed Media URLs (core/media_access.py)
nodes.rationale: /media/ was publicly readable (data leak); signed 24h-expiring URLs gate question_papers/ and materials/; generated_images stay open because the editor iframe needs them and they are not school-sensitive.

nodes.label: MCQ Answer Auto-Correction (V4 two-pass)
nodes.rationale: A wrong key is overwritten only when two independent blind passes pick the same different option with high confidence, so a single model opinion can never flip a correct key to a wrong one; lesser disagreements stay as suspect flags for human review.

nodes.label: _generation_blocked Spend/Concurrency Guard
nodes.rationale: Blocks a second concurrent generation per user (anti-spam) and enforces the school token budget, returning HTTP 429; the budget is a total cap — no monthly reset counter exists yet.

nodes.label: Paper Marks Audit (core/paper_audit.py)
nodes.rationale: OR-aware per-section audit counts an internal-choice pair once and names the exact failing section and cause; warn-don't-block by design — surfaced on the Completed-with-warning badge; found all 5 existing completed papers failing.

nodes.label: _owner_scope Visibility Model
nodes.rationale: Papers are private per teacher because exam content is sensitive; patterns/blueprints/templates are school-wide shared because they are reusable structures, not content; materials stay school-wide as a shared generation resource.

nodes.label: Embedding Dimension Mismatch Fix (fix_embedding_dims)
nodes.rationale: Class 11 corpus was embedded at 2048-dim (OpenRouter nemotron) but queried at 768-dim (Ollama nomic-embed-text), so ChromaDB rejected every query and papers shipped ungrounded silently; fix re-embeds mismatched collections with the local model; defense-in-depth: query detects the mismatch, logs one actionable line and returns empty instead of silently shipping an ungrounded paper.

nodes.label: cache_only Re-render Mode (ImageNotCached)
nodes.rationale: Synchronous re-render endpoints must never call external image APIs (worst case ~10 minutes per uncached image blocked the web request until timeout); images are already prompt-hash cached during async generation, so re-render only reuses them and skips uncached ones.

nodes.label: plan_chapter_allocation
nodes.rationale: Deterministically assigns each question slot a chapter, weighted by UNIT_MARKS_WEIGHTS where known and uniform otherwise, using a weight/(1+already_covered) greedy coordinated across the whole paper so later sections fill earlier gaps before any chapter repeats; previously the LLM picked chapters itself with no coordination.

nodes.label: enforce_section_question_types
nodes.rationale: Three layers: a mandatory QUESTION TYPE prompt block, an allowed-category set in validation (uniform sections previously had no type check at all), and a post-generation safety net that removes wrong-type questions using COARSE categories so legitimate subtypes (assertion-reason as MCQ, map-based as SA) are never dropped.

nodes.label: _is_generic_image_stem Guard
nodes.rationale: A stem is only turned into an image prompt when it actually describes a visual; generic 'observe the diagram and answer' pointers fed to the image generator produced meaningless second images (the CEO/Manager org chart on a Chemistry question).

nodes.label: _top_up_short_section
nodes.rationale: After retries, a section merely short on count gets one focused follow-up call for exactly the missing questions on still-uncovered chapters; strictly additive (valid, correctly-typed, non-duplicate, never more than the shortfall) so it can never worsen the section; AR-containing sections get a 400-token/question budget because 16 AR questions truncated at the old 4980-token cap.

nodes.label: UsageEvent Append-Only Usage Log
nodes.rationale: Per-user usage was recomputed from live QuestionPaper rows, so deleting papers erased usage (school counter showed 1,548,060 tokens while the per-user table summed to 171,495); append-only events survive paper deletion and support monthly windows; backfill migration stamps events with each paper's own created_at.

nodes.label: Post-Validation Refill Pass
nodes.rationale: The type-enforcer and semantic dedup run after per-section validation has passed, so their removals shipped sections silently short (paper 66: 68/80 marks); generate_paper_parallel now refills any section below its work-order count via _top_up_short_section before renumbering, closing the gap for both type-drop and dedup-trim.

nodes.label: Hindi & Tamil Language Support
nodes.rationale: _pick_script_font picks Latha (Tamil) or Nirmala UI (Devanagari) by subject name or script scan of generated text; _language_directive injects a mandatory write-in-target-language block into all three generation prompts; retrieval needs no change because the chapter filter works regardless of query language.

nodes.label: Intelligent Material Ingestion (core/material_intel.py)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in, default OFF, best-effort (never raises into the caller), runs in async ingest tasks — zero launch risk; detected chapter names are snapped to the official CBSE catalog (UNIT_MARKS_WEIGHTS); whole-book split uses PDF bookmarks/outline with a Chapter-N heading-scan fallback.

nodes.label: HTML Book Import (extract_html_chapters)
nodes.rationale: HTML beats PDF for Indic scripts: proper Unicode, real heading tags, no OCR, no PyPDF2 ligature mangling; segments by the heading level whose headings carry a chapter marker; validated on the real Class-10 Tamil book — 31 clean chapters, 505K chars of Unicode Tamil.

nodes.label: QuestionPaper.status_detail
nodes.rationale: Persists the failure reason and audit warnings so the dashboard can show why: Failed-badge tooltip, Completed-with-warning badge popup, and a Stalled state (>15 min generating) with a working Retry.

nodes.label: question_slots (Per-Question Pattern Structure)
nodes.rationale: Section-level aggregates destroyed the teacher's per-question intent, which was then guessed back by an inference chain at generation time; slots become the source of truth and legacy aggregates are derived at save time so every existing consumer keeps working; named question_slots (not questions) because the CBSE-seeded dialect already uses questions as an integer count.

nodes.label: Slot Schema (qnum/type/marks/parts/choice)
nodes.rationale: marks is always the attempted value for the printed question; parts marks-sum rules differ for open vs internal choice; ranges in source text ('Q1-4 MCQs') expand to one slot per qnum; a slot's source says where its material comes from.

nodes.label: Canonical Slot Type Enum
nodes.rationale: Free-form question types classified to 'other' in _type_category and silently disabled type-aware logic (the Tamil-paper failure); type is a closed enum mapped to pipeline categories while format/topic carry the free text that used to pollute the type field.

nodes.label: derive_aggregates_from_slots
nodes.rationale: Back-compat layer: components that never learn about slots (paper_audit, frontend read-only pages, ExamPattern.save totals) still see consistent aggregates recomputed from slots.

nodes.label: validate_pattern_structure (core/pattern_structure.py)
nodes.rationale: Teacher-source arithmetic conflicts (9 questions declared vs 7 marks) surface at pattern time as warnings via one repair call instead of silently reshaping the printed paper; residual errors are stored as _structure_warnings and the pattern still saves so generation falls back gracefully.

nodes.label: Slot-Driven Work Orders (build_work_orders)
nodes.rationale: When a section has question_slots, SectionWorkOrder.slots carries the normalized slots and the heuristic inference chain (mpq-list patching, subsection synthesis, typical-marks fallbacks) is bypassed entirely.

nodes.label: PER-QUESTION SPEC Prompt Block
nodes.rationale: Slot sections get a per-question spec block instead of the derived qpos_block; topic strings finally reach the generation LLM; or_alternative is required only on choice=='internal' slots while the LA-blanket OR rule stays for slot-less sections.

nodes.label: Slot-Aware Rendering (no regroup/re-stamp)
nodes.rationale: Skipping _regroup_section reordering and _section_type_marks re-stamping for slot-driven sections retires the two recurring bug families: category marks stamping and printed-vs-storage qnum divergence.

nodes.label: Multi-Stage Validation Pipeline (V1-V10)
nodes.rationale: Time and LLM cost are explicitly not constraints — maximise quality; ~98 LLM calls vs 4-8 before (2-3x tokens, 15x call count, but calls are small and run in parallel).

nodes.label: V1 Full Structural Validation
nodes.rationale: Previously only the first 3 questions were checked for text/options; V1 checks ALL questions with type-aware rules plus answer-key distribution bias, and is the only blocking gate — failures feed back into a retry prompt as prior_error.

nodes.label: V2 Per-Question Content Quality Critic
nodes.rationale: qwen3-32b scores each question on clarity, NCERT faithfulness, difficulty match, answer correctness and distractor quality; if <=30% of questions fail, regenerate individually; >30% triggers full section regeneration.

nodes.label: V3 NCERT Grounding Check
nodes.rationale: Re-queries the vector store using the question text and asks whether the question is answerable from NCERT; guarded against false positives — if retrieval returned 0 chars for that chapter, V3 is skipped for its questions and the skip is logged.

nodes.label: V4 MCQ Blind Answer Verification
nodes.rationale: A fresh LLM answers each MCQ with NO context; the original design flags mismatches rather than auto-correcting because the blind LLM could be wrong on a tricky question (later upgraded in launch fixes to two-pass auto-correction); also checks answer-letter distribution.

nodes.label: V5 Inter-Question Uniqueness
nodes.rationale: Two layers: cheap token-overlap check (_concept_overlap > 0.45 flags likely duplicates) then an LLM semantic confirmation only for flagged pairs; the duplicate with the lower V2 quality score is regenerated.

nodes.label: V6 CBQ Passage Validation
nodes.rationale: Every sub-question must be answerable SOLELY from the passage (not general knowledge), with length and age-appropriateness checks; max 2 regen attempts before accepting with a logged warning.

nodes.label: V7 Bloom's/Competency Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Upgrades competency distribution from report-only to enforcement via targeted swaps of the cheapest-to-replace questions; accepts the paper with a logged violation after 2 fix rounds rather than blocking indefinitely.

nodes.label: V8 Cross-Section Coherence Audit
nodes.rationale: Paper-level LLM audit of chapter coverage, cross-section concept repeats and subject focus; only triggers targeted regeneration when critical issues exist AND coherence score < 6, otherwise accepts with a logged report.

nodes.label: V9 Image Pipeline Validation
nodes.rationale: Generates 3 Pollinations candidates with prompt variations, has Kimi vision rank them, then runs a dedicated scientific-accuracy check (score < 7 rejects the image, falling back to the next candidate or Wikimedia); also verifies sub-question answerability from the image.

nodes.label: V10 Final Paper-Level LLM Audit
nodes.rationale: The most capable model (deepseek.v3.2) performs one holistic CBSE-compliance audit per paper; reject_all should be rare — one full regeneration attempt then accept the best result.

nodes.label: Cross-Section Context Deduplication
nodes.rationale: All sections queried the same vector store and received overlapping chunks, producing similar questions across sections; a shared used_doc_ids set excludes already-used chunks, with a simpler content-string 'seen' set alternative when chunk_id metadata is absent.

nodes.label: Per-Question-Type Context Routing (TYPE_CONTEXT_PROFILES)
nodes.rationale: One context blob per section served all question types, but MCQ needs dense facts, LA needs explanatory passages and CBQ needs narrative passages; context is sized and routed per type via a context_by_type dict on the work order.

nodes.label: Context Quality Pre-Check (_validate_context_quality)
nodes.rationale: Context was retrieved and used blindly — thin context produced hallucinated questions; a cheap LLM check asks if the context suffices for N questions and retries with a broader chapter-less query on NO; <500 chars fails immediately without spending an LLM call.

nodes.label: Individual LA/CBQ Generation (generate_single_question)
nodes.rationale: One LLM call per complex question is more expensive (~5 extra calls per paper) but dramatically improves quality for LA/CBQ by giving each question dedicated context attention; a used_chapters set forces chapter diversity.

nodes.label: Adaptive Generation Parameters (TYPE_PARAMS)
nodes.rationale: Temperature and token budget vary per question type — low temperature for factual MCQ/map work, higher for LA creativity; upgrades estimate_token_budget to also return temperature.

nodes.label: QPG Improvement Plan
nodes.rationale: Order: fix bugs, then fix format, then go agentic — nothing else matters until active silent failures are stopped; explicitly lists what NOT to change: the two-LLM generator-validator pattern, Celery async architecture, DRF token auth, round-robin key management, and SQLite until concurrent write errors appear.

nodes.label: Global __HEADER_META__ Race Condition (Bug 1)
nodes.rationale: Under concurrent Celery workers, Paper A silently gets Paper B's class/time/marks in the Word header because generate_with_universal_prompt writes globals()['__HEADER_META__'] that render_docx reads; fix is passing header_meta as an explicit parameter.

nodes.label: MCQ Options Dropped in render_pdf (Bug 2)
nodes.rationale: render_pdf has no opts_block branch, so the 2x2 MCQ option table produced by render_section_questions is silently ignored — students receive unanswerable PDF papers.

nodes.label: Embedding Fallback Permanently Broken (Bug 3)
nodes.rationale: ollama_embed falls back to titan_embed, which unconditionally raises RuntimeError('bedrock-runtime is not accessible'), so any Ollama restart/timeout kills all generation; fix is graceful degradation — a zero vector (generation continues without RAG) or a domain-specific EmbeddingUnavailableError.

nodes.label: Teacher Instructions Stripped by normalize_blueprint (Bug 4)
nodes.rationale: passage_instruction, extract_instruction, instructions and constraints are stored correctly on ExamPattern.sections but silently discarded by normalize_blueprint before the LLM prompt is built — the LLM never sees them.

nodes.label: ExamPattern total_marks Drift (Bug 5)
nodes.rationale: No save() override recalculates the denormalised total_marks/total_questions, so after a section edit the LLM prompt includes the wrong total and generates a paper for the wrong mark total.

nodes.label: Semantic Deduplication Never Active (Bug 6)
nodes.rationale: check_question_similarity's collection.query call lacked include=['embeddings'], so results['embeddings'] was always falsy and similarity silently fell back to naive 70% word overlap every time — a one-word fix.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Format Fix (CBSE DOCX Rendering)
nodes.rationale: The LLM produces reasonable content that the renderer throws away — an 80% rendering problem, not a generation problem; covers school name from settings, Word header section, general instructions block, bordered passage boxes, right-aligned marks, OR horizontal rules, hard-coded AR options, page-number footers and explicit font sizes.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Agentic Pipeline (Orchestrator/Section/Validator)
nodes.rationale: A 200+ line single prompt degrades LLM attention and one truncation collapses the whole paper; per-section ~70-line prompts run in parallel (max 3 workers), failed sections retry individually, and the existing single-prompt path stays as automatic fallback until 50+ successful parallel generations in production.

nodes.label: SectionWorkOrder Dataclass
nodes.rationale: Carries one section's full generation spec (marks, counts, types, instructions) plus pre-fetched section-specific RAG context and an estimated output token budget — the unit of work for parallel generation.

nodes.label: RAG Improvements (Chunking/Metadata/bge-m3)
nodes.rationale: Replace fixed 800-char zero-overlap chunks with sentence-aware 512-token chunks with 75-token overlap (requires re-ingesting PDFs); add per-chunk metadata; upgrade the English-only 384d all-minilm embedder to multilingual 1024d BAAI/bge-m3 for Hindi NCERT.

nodes.label: estimate_token_budget (Dynamic max_tokens)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the hardcoded 4096 max_tokens that truncated complex papers; budget is computed from question counts and passage presence, capped at 8192.

nodes.label: Async Paper Generation Flow
nodes.rationale: The HTTP request returns before the paper exists (201 queued + task_id); the browser polls /api/papers/ every 3 seconds until done/failed while a Celery worker (via Redis) does RAG + LLM generation + validation + DOCX rendering.

nodes.label: Failure Escalation Ladder
nodes.rationale: A failure almost never aborts the paper — it degrades to a cheaper strategy (parallel per-section -> single-prompt -> legacy generator); trade-off: the fallback paths run at most the V1 structural check, so a fallback paper is structurally sound but un-audited.

nodes.label: Ten Validation Gates (Only V1 Blocks)
nodes.rationale: V1 structural validation is the only blocking gate, running inside each section's retry loop; V2-V10 warn, auto-fix or annotate, storing underscore-prefixed flags that are dumped to temp_questions.json and summarized into status_detail so every finding is teacher-visible.

nodes.label: Per-Section Retry Loop
nodes.rationale: Up to MAX_SECTION_RETRIES=2 retries feed the exact V1 errors back into the next prompt; after that the section ships _partial with _errors, keeping whatever questions it has — nothing is discarded.

nodes.label: Single-Prompt Fallback Generator
nodes.rationale: Triggered when 2 or more sections fail hard in the parallel pipeline; validates loosely (V1 per section only, no V2-V10 chain); legacy english/science generators remain as the final fallback.

nodes.label: RAG Retrieval (ChromaDB + nomic-embed-text)
nodes.rationale: Per section: embed the query at 768d with Ollama nomic-embed-text, cosine-search school-then-shared ChromaDB collections, weight chunks by CBSE UNIT_MARKS_WEIGHTS, dedupe and cap per question type; empty results or dim-mismatch are never fatal — the section proceeds with no context and the prompt tells the model to use its own CBSE knowledge.

nodes.label: Next.js Frontend
nodes.rationale: Bootstrapped with create-next-app; dev server via npm run dev on localhost:3000; uses next/font to load the Geist font family.

nodes.label: Frontend robots.txt Disallow-All Policy
nodes.rationale: QPG is an internal tool with everything behind auth, so all crawlers (including AI training crawlers like GPTBot/ClaudeBot) are disallowed from indexing anything.

nodes.label: Backend robots.txt Disallow-All Policy
nodes.rationale: Same disallow-all policy for the QPG backend: internal tool, nothing to index, all content behind auth.
